result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major navigation state mismatch and a minor contrast issue on an image badge.

issues.description: Visual state mismatch: The bottom navigation bar highlights the 'Profile' tab in green, but the main content area displays a Home/Discovery feed with search, categories, and restaurant lists. The 'Home' tab should be the active one.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active state of the bottom navigation corresponds to the currently displayed screen. The 'Home' tab should be highlighted when showing this feed.

issues.description: Poor contrast on time badge: The '15-25 min' badge on the 'Green Bowl Poké' card has a white background that blends into the light-colored image behind it, reducing readability compared to the badges on darker images.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle border or shadow to the badge, or use a darker semi-transparent background to ensure consistent contrast across all image backgrounds.
